reviewer: Codex inspection of actual exported/reimported renders
findings: Refined prototype review, not final production art or human approval. Front/rear/clay show a tapered slide and chassis, a bored forward barrel, joined grip shell, continuous open trigger guard and curved trigger blade. No separate grip ribs or sideways barrel disk.

Rear wall is visibly closed; independent exported-model rays measure 15.7–16.5 mm of rear grip wall at three sampled heights. Complete 144 mm magazine withdraws along the raked well; ten sampled reload poses have no grip/magazine surface intersections.

Front and rear receiver stencils read in their correct orientations. Coated blue-black body, exposed steel and patterned dark grip use a shared 1024 albedo plus linear roughness/metallic texture and padded per-part UV cells. Deliberately restrained wear; no normal map or high-poly detail claimed.

Compared actual private car-01, car-08, character-01 and character-17 render panels. Chamfered silhouette, recessed functional details, markings and consistent materials meet a modest refined-prototype stage. The references retain richer painted character/weathering detail; that remains a future art pass.
Vesper remains a shared first-eight world pickup. Neutral field-service design does not invent a mapping to Unraveled, Penitent or Begotten and uses no placeholder faction labels.
